verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Smart Meetings are documented to find the best time to meet across all attendees' schedules (docs-5). Smart events are prioritized and automatically rescheduled as conflicts come up (docs-33, docs-34, docs-29), and Smart Meetings keep moving until they auto-lock at 4am on the day of the meeting (docs-41), which supports continuous optimization rather than first-open-slot booking. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the 'best' time is chosen across attendees (it appears only as a feature tagline), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Smart Meetings' cross-attendee optimization.
